verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same broken banner. Each line pair is pulled apart: 'When Life Is Rough' sits in the top-left corner while its 'PRAY' floats far below and to the right, the two text pairs sit on different baselines, every line of text is tiny with no clear headline, and the original's hairline divider has become a heavy, thick bar. B is marginally less bad because its left 'PRAY' sits a little closer to its line and the right pair is slightly more compact, but both still leave large dead gaps between scattered pieces of text and the rose.
